<Center><DIV STYLE="width:8.5in" align="left">
 <P STYLE="margin-top:0pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman" ALIGN="right"><B>Exhibit 10.1 </B></P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman" ALIGN="center"><B><FONT STYLE="white-space:nowrap">SUB-ADMINISTRATIVE</FONT> SERVICES AGREEMENT </B></P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:4%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">AGREEMENT made as of <B>October 12, 2026, </B>and effective as of <B>October 12, 2026 </B>(the &#8220;Effective Date&#8221;), by and among
<B>HS Financial Technologies Corporation</B>, a corporation incorporated in the State of Delaware (&#8220;HSFT&#8221;), <B>Silver Point Private Credit Fund Management, LLC</B>, in its capacity as administrator of the Fund (the
&#8220;Administrator&#8221;), and <B>Silver Point Private Credit Fund </B>(the &#8220;Fund&#8221;), (each a &#8220;Party&#8221; and, collectively, the &#8220;Parties&#8221;). </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:24pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman" ALIGN="center"><U>W I T N E S S E T H: </U></P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:4%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">WHEREAS, HSFT is in the business of providing bookkeeping, fund accounting, and certain fund administration services to investment funds; and
</P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:4%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">WHEREAS, the Fund and the Administrator have entered into that certain Administration Agreement (the &#8220;Administration
Agreement&#8221;), dated as of February&nbsp;2, 2026, pursuant to which the Fund engaged the Administrator to act as administrator of the Fund; </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:4%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">WHEREAS, the Fund is in the business of investing in securities and other investments, as is more fully described in the Fund&#8217;s
currently effective confidential private placement memorandum (as the same may be amended, modified, or supplemented from time to time, collectively, the &#8220;Offering Memorandum&#8221;), a copy of which have been received and reviewed by HSFT;
</P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:4%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">WHEREAS, the Fund has elected to be regulated as a business development company under the Investment Company Act of 1940, as amended (the
&#8220;1940 Act&#8221;); </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:4%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">WHEREAS, pursuant to the Administration Agreement, the Fund has agreed to reimburse the Administrator for the
costs and expenses incurred by the Administrator in performing its obligations thereunder, including the expenses of one or more administrators or <FONT STYLE="white-space:nowrap">sub-administrators</FONT> of the Fund, and the Administrator is
authorized to enter into <FONT STYLE="white-space:nowrap">sub-administration</FONT> agreements, subject to the prior approval of the Fund; </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:4%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">WHEREAS, the Fund and the Administrator desire for the Administrator to retain HSFT as
<FONT STYLE="white-space:nowrap">sub-administrator</FONT> to provide accounting and administrative services to the Fund, and the Administrator and the Fund wish to enter into this <FONT STYLE="white-space:nowrap">Sub-Administrative</FONT> Services
Agreement (as the same may be amended or supplemented by addendum or otherwise, this &#8220;Agreement&#8221;) in order to set forth the terms and conditions upon which HSFT will render and implement the services specified herein to the Fund; and
</P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:4%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">NOW, THEREFORE, in consideration of the premises and mutual covenants contained herein and other good and valuable consideration, the
receipt and adequacy of which are hereby acknowledged, the Parties hereto agree as follows: </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:4%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">1. <U>Duties</U><U> </U><U>of</U><U>
</U><U>HSFT</U>. </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:4%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">(a) From and after the Effective Date, HSFT agrees to provide the services listed on <U>Exhibit A</U> with respect to
the Fund in connection with the Fund&#8217;s business and operations. HSFT shall also perform all actions necessary in order to perform the Services in accordance with the terms of this Agreement. </P>
 <p STYLE="margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:0pt ; font-size:8pt">&nbsp;</P> <P STYLE="margin-top:0pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman" ALIGN="center">1 </P>

</DIV></Center>


<p style="margin-top:1em; margin-bottom:0em; page-break-before:always"> </p>
<HR SIZE="3" style="COLOR:#999999" WIDTH="100%" ALIGN="CENTER">

<Center><DIV STYLE="width:8.5in" align="left">
 <P STYLE="margin-top:0pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:4%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">(b) As part of the Services, HSFT shall grant to the Fund and the Administrator a limited,
personal, <FONT STYLE="white-space:nowrap">non-transferable,</FONT> <FONT STYLE="white-space:nowrap">non-exclusive,</FONT> license to access and use HSFT&#8217;s file transfer protocol site (the &#8220;FTP Site&#8221;), subject to and in accordance
with the terms of this Agreement. </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:4%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">(c) HSFT will maintain the books and records created or received by it in the performance of the
Services, including electronic books and records. Upon request of the Fund or the Administrator, HSFT shall provide copies of any such books and records to the Fund or the Administrator, on behalf of the Fund, including electronically readable
electronic or computer disk copies of any such books and records which are kept in such format. The Fund, the Administrator and such other persons or entities authorized to act on behalf of the Fund (including, without limitation, the Fund&#8217;s
auditor) shall have the right to inspect such books and records during HSFT&#8217;s normal business hours or, upon reasonable notice, at such other times as may be necessary. All such books and records shall be preserved by HSFT for a period of at
least seven (7)&nbsp;years or such longer period of time as a competent authority or the laws, rules and regulations applicable to the Fund may require or as otherwise reasonably requested by the Fund or the Administrator in order to comply with
applicable law or its internal policy, unless they are delivered to duly appointed successors to HSFT or to the Fund or the Administrator, on behalf of the Fund, upon termination of this Agreement. HSFT shall maintain and preserve such books and
records as are required to be maintained and preserved under Section&nbsp;31(a) of the 1940 Act and Rules <FONT STYLE="white-space:nowrap">31a-1,</FONT> <FONT STYLE="white-space:nowrap">31a-2</FONT> and <FONT STYLE="white-space:nowrap">31a-3</FONT>
thereunder, and HSFT agrees that all such records it maintains for the Fund are the property of the Fund, shall be surrendered promptly upon request, and shall be made available for examination at any time, or from time to time, during business
hours by representatives or designees of the Securities and Exchange Commission. HSFT acknowledges that the books and records maintained and preserved by HSFT pursuant to this Agreement are the property of the Fund and will be delivered to the Fund
or the Administrator, on behalf of the Fund, (including in electronically readable electronic or computer disk format) promptly upon reasonable request or upon termination of this Agreement. If HSFT receives any request or demand for the inspection
of any records of the Fund, to the extent it is legally permissible to do so, HSFT will promptly notify the Fund and the Administrator of such request or demand for inspection to secure instruction from the Fund or the Administrator as to such
inspection. Unless, in the reasonable opinion of HSFT, abiding with any such instructions received from the Fund or the Administrator would result in a breach of any applicable law, order or regulation to which HSFT, the Fund and/or the
Administrator are subject, HSFT shall abide by the Fund&#8217;s or the Administrator&#8217;s instructions for granting or denying the inspection. Notwithstanding the foregoing, HSFT may grant the inspection without instructions or in contravention
of specific instructions of the Fund or the Administrator if HSFT is advised by legal counsel to HSFT or the Fund that failure to do so would result in HSFT or the Fund incurring any liability or being in breach of any applicable law, order or
regulation to which the Fund and/or the Administrator and/or HSFT is subject. </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:4%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">(d) HSFT represents, warrants and undertakes that
(i)&nbsp;it has adopted and implemented risk-based written policies, procedures and internal controls reasonably designed to develop, maintain, monitor, assess and test and to prevent and detect money laundering which are compliant with the laws,
rules and regulations applicable to the domicile of the Fund including internal control procedures that require HSFT to develop, maintain, monitor, assess and test anti-money laundering compliance systems and controls and report suspicious activity
(the &#8220;Procedures&#8221;), (ii) the Procedures include investor and relevant beneficial owner information collection and identity </P>
 <p STYLE="margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:0pt ; font-size:8pt">&nbsp;</P> <P STYLE="margin-top:0pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman" ALIGN="center">2 </P>

</DIV></Center>


<p style="margin-top:1em; margin-bottom:0em; page-break-before:always"> </p>
<HR SIZE="3" style="COLOR:#999999" WIDTH="100%" ALIGN="CENTER">

<Center><DIV STYLE="width:8.5in" align="left">
 <P STYLE="margin-top:0pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">verification (and where applicable and required, identification and verification of controlling persons,
authorized persons and intermediaries of such investors), ascertaining that a person purporting to act on behalf of an investor is properly authorized, identified and verified, ongoing employee training, record keeping and suspicious activity
reporting requirements, the adoption of a risk-based approach to identify, assess, determine and monitor money laundering, terrorist financing and proliferation financing risks in relation to investors and the business relationship, internal
controls and communication for the ongoing monitoring of business relationships with investors for the purpose of preventing money laundering, terrorist financing and proliferation financing and are designed to adhere to the requirements of the
laws, rules and regulations applicable to the Fund including applicable laws, rules and regulations promulgated under the USA PATRIOT Act, as amended from time to time, (iii)&nbsp;HSFT&#8217;s Procedures provide for screening the names and personal
identifying information of each prospective investor (<I>i.e., </I>someone who has submitted a completed subscription agreement that has not yet been confirmed, not a potential investor), and, to the extent known, any of such investor&#8217;s
directors, general partners, trustees, settlors, beneficiaries, or beneficial owners (as applicable) against the sanctions lists administered and published by Office of Foreign Assets Control of the U.S. Department of the Treasury, including the
list of specially designated nationals and blocked persons, and similar lists administered pursuant to European Union, United Kingdom or Cayman Islands laws and regulations, as such lists may be amended from time to time (collectively, the
&#8220;Sanctions List&#8221;) prior to acceptance of any initial subscription by the Fund and thereafter screening such names against the Sanctions List prior to processing any subscription, transfer or redemption by the investor and whenever the
Sanctions List is updated or on at least a monthly basis, and reviewing to identify that such prospective investor (and any of such investor&#8217;s beneficial owners, directors, general partners, trustees, settlors or beneficiaries, as applicable)
are not operationally based or domiciled in a country or territory in relation to which country-wide comprehensive sanctions have been issued by the United Nations, United States, European Union or United Kingdom, (iv)&nbsp;it will immediately
notify the Administrator if it knows or has reason to suspect that a subscribing or existing investor (or applicable beneficial owner) is engaging in or attempting to engage in suspicious activity related to a possible violation of law, (v)&nbsp;it
is properly enforcing, and will continue to enforce, the Procedures, including in its performance of the Services, in all respects, and will notify the Fund and the Administrator if it is unable to adhere to its Procedures in any way, and will
provide annual <FONT STYLE="white-space:nowrap">re-certification</FONT> of the same upon request by the Fund or the Administrator, (vi)&nbsp;copies of the relevant investor identification records and, where applicable, the principal beneficial
owners on whose behalf an investor makes an investment, are kept by it for at least seven (7)&nbsp;years after each investor&#8217;s relationship with the Fund has ended and will be made available to the Fund or the Administrator, on behalf of the
Fund, and, to the extent required by and permissible under applicable law, governmental authorities having jurisdiction over the Fund, (vii) if an investor indicates or HSFT learns through any means that the investor is (A)&nbsp;included on the
Sanctions List, (B)&nbsp;a senior foreign political figure or an immediate family member or close associate of such a figure, or (C)&nbsp;a foreign shell bank, then HSFT shall promptly notify the Fund and the Administrator of such information,
(viii)&nbsp;it will promptly notify the Fund and the Administrator if (A)&nbsp;any documentation required in the subscription document is not received, or (B) any investor does not make, or alters, a representation in the subscription document,
(vi)&nbsp;it shall update or amend the Procedures as may be necessary in order to comply with all applicable laws, rules and regulations as such are amended or adopted from time to time and will notify the Fund and the Administrator of any such
updates or amendments to its Procedures, and will comply with such revisions with respect to subsequent investors, (vii)&nbsp;it will provide the Fund or the Administrator, upon request, with any documents and/or information kept by HSFT on behalf
of the Fund with respect to investors in the Fund in order to assist the Fund in its compliance with </P>
 <p STYLE="margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:0pt ; font-size:8pt">&nbsp;</P> <P STYLE="margin-top:0pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman" ALIGN="center">3 </P>

</DIV></Center>


<p style="margin-top:1em; margin-bottom:0em; page-break-before:always"> </p>
<HR SIZE="3" style="COLOR:#999999" WIDTH="100%" ALIGN="CENTER">

<Center><DIV STYLE="width:8.5in" align="left">
 <P STYLE="margin-top:0pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">applicable laws and regulations, and (viii)&nbsp;it will provide to the Fund or the Administrator, upon
request, a copy of its Procedures (including any policies and procedures regarding the acceptance of Electronic Signatures (defined below) and any policies and procedures designed to protect Confidential Information (defined below)) and will
promptly provide the Fund and the Administrator with any and all material amendments thereto. HSFT will process all transaction documents of the Fund (<I>e.g., </I>in respect of subscriptions, transfers, withdrawals, redemptions) in accordance with
its Procedures, and the procedures established by the Fund and as provided in the Fund&#8217; subscription documents. HSFT acknowledges that the Fund is relying on HSFT&#8217;s Procedures and the performance of the services listed in this
Section&nbsp;1(d). </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:4%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">(e) HSFT represents and warrants that it (i)&nbsp;has, and for the term of this Agreement shall continue to have
written policies, procedures and internal controls reasonably designed to prevent, detect and mitigate identity theft with respect to investors that may arise in the performance of HSFT&#8217;s activities hereunder, (ii)&nbsp;shall take appropriate
steps to prevent or mitigate identity theft in accordance with the policies and procedures set forth in Section&nbsp;1(e)(i), (iii) shall promptly report any instances of &#8220;Red Flags&#8221; as defined hereunder to the Fund and the Administrator
and (iv)&nbsp;will update or amend the policies and procedures described in this Section&nbsp;1(e) as may be necessary in order to comply with all applicable laws, rules and regulations. As used herein a &#8220;Red Flag&#8221; is a pattern,
practice, or specific activity that indicates the possible existence of identity theft with respect to an investor, as further described in Regulation <FONT STYLE="white-space:nowrap">S-ID</FONT> issued by the Securities and Exchange Commission.
HSFT will process all subscription documents of the Fund in accordance with and in furtherance of the policies and procedures described in this Section&nbsp;1(e). HSFT acknowledges that the Fund and the Administrator are relying on HSFT&#8217;s
representations, warranties and undertakings listed in this Section&nbsp;1. HSFT shall, upon the reasonable request of and at least twice per year, provide to the Fund and the Administrator sufficient documentation to enable them to assess
HSFT&#8217;s compliance with this Section&nbsp;1(e) and any applicable rules and regulations. </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:4%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">(f) HSFT undertakes to comply in all
material respects with any laws, rules and regulations of governmental authorities having jurisdiction with respect to the duties to be performed by HSFT hereunder. In performing all services under this Agreement, HSFT shall act in conformity with
the Fund&#8217;s Confidential Offering Memorandum, Declaration of Trust, Bylaws and any other applicable governing documents, as amended from time to time (collectively, the &#8220;Governing Documents&#8221;), along with Proper Instructions (defined
below) and all laws, rules and regulations applicable to its delivery of the fund administration services contemplated herein. HSFT shall act in conformity with any amendment to the Governing Documents upon delivery by the Fund or the Administrator
of such amendment or proposed amendment to HSFT and a reasonable amount of time afforded to HSFT to review such amendment (such time not to exceed five business days), provided, however, that with respect to any such amendment that materially amends
any of the terms under this Agreement, such an amendment shall only be effectuated on HSFT upon written affirmation and acceptance by HSFT (such affirmation and acceptance not to be unreasonably withheld or delayed). </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:4%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">(g) The Fund and the Administrator shall use best efforts to procure that HSFT is authorized to request any and all information, confirmations
or statements from investors, distributors, financial intermediaries or other agents appointed by or on behalf of the Fund, as HSFT deems necessary to properly enforce the Procedures. The Fund or the Administrator shall, upon request, provide to
HSFT copies of any distribution or agency arrangements entered into by the Fund. </P>
 <p STYLE="margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:0pt ; font-size:8pt">&nbsp;</P> <P STYLE="margin-top:0pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman" ALIGN="center">4 </P>

</DIV></Center>


<p style="margin-top:1em; margin-bottom:0em; page-break-before:always"> </p>
<HR SIZE="3" style="COLOR:#999999" WIDTH="100%" ALIGN="CENTER">

<Center><DIV STYLE="width:8.5in" align="left">
 <P STYLE="margin-top:0pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:4%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">(h) HSFT shall process all subscriptions, conversion and redemption orders for shares of the
Fund and all supporting documents provided to HSFT by investors, distributors, financial intermediaries or other agents appointed by or on behalf of the Fund in accordance with such Procedures and the procedures established by the Fund and as
provided in the Fund&#8217; subscription documents. HSFT may (but is under no obligation to) reject orders that it believes in good faith do not comply with the Procedures or that are incomplete, including where the Fund, investors, distributors,
financial intermediaries or other agents appointed by or on behalf of the Fund fail to provide any information or documentation requested by HSFT, in its good faith discretion, in order to properly enforce the Procedures; provided that prior to any
such rejection, HSFT shall liaise with the Fund or the Administrator, on behalf of the Fund. </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:4%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">(i) HSFT shall put in place procedures to
assist the Fund in verifying that only investors satisfying the eligibility requirements set out in the Offering Memorandum or the operative documents of the Fund (collectively, the &#8220;Fund Documents&#8221;), if any, are permitted to hold shares
of the Fund (&#8220;Eligible Investors&#8221;). For that purpose, HSFT is authorized and instructed to rely upon any information, documents or certifications it receives from the investors or the Fund or any third party agent authorized by the Fund
to provide such information, documents or certifications to HSFT (each, together with each party listed on Exhibit C hereto, an &#8220;Authorized Third Party&#8221;). The Administrator and the Fund shall have access to such information, documents or
certifications upon request. Except with respect to confirming the information requested by the Fund&#8217;s subscription agreements has been provided, HSFT has no duty to review, confirm or otherwise assume any responsibility with respect to the
accuracy or completeness of any such information, documents or certifications and shall be without liability for any loss or damage suffered by the Fund as a result of HSFT&#8217;s reliance thereon and utilization thereof. Orders for subscription to
shares or interests (as applicable) of the Fund rejected by HSFT (whether of its own determination or following instructions from the Fund or its agents) on that basis may be subsequently accepted and processed only upon Proper Instructions of the
Fund confirming that the prospective investor is an Eligible Investor. </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:4%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">(j) HSFT shall promptly notify the Administrator and the Fund
(including, for the avoidance of doubt the Fund&#8217; chief compliance officer) of matters that may materially adversely affect the Fund, the Administrator or the performance by HSFT of the Services. </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:4%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">(k) HSFT shall at all times liaise with the Fund or the Administrator, on behalf of the Fund, prior to the exercise of its discretion to
reject orders or enforce the Procedures. </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:4%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">(l) HSFT acknowledges that the Administrator and the Fund are relying upon HSFT&#8217;s
performance of the services specified in <U>Exhibit A</U>. HSFT shall not delegate any of its obligations hereunder without the written consent of the Fund and the Administrator; <U>provided</U>, <U>however</U>, that neither the Fund nor the
Administrator shall unreasonably withhold its consent to the delegation by HSFT of any of its obligations hereunder to an affiliate and <U>provided</U>, <U>further</U>, that such delegation shall not relieve HSFT of its obligations hereunder to the
Administrator and the Fund. </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:4%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">(m) HSFT shall (i)&nbsp;deliver to the Administrator, promptly following issuance and in any event not less
than annually, a copy of HSFT&#8217;s SOC 1 Type II report (or any successor report) covering the Services, together with any related bridge letter; (ii)&nbsp;provide the Fund, the Administrator and the Fund&#8217;s independent registered public
accounting firm with such information, certifications, <FONT STYLE="white-space:nowrap">sub-certifications</FONT> and access as they may reasonably request in </P>
 <p STYLE="margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:0pt ; font-size:8pt">&nbsp;</P> <P STYLE="margin-top:0pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman" ALIGN="center">5 </P>

</DIV></Center>

<HR SIZE="3" style="COLOR:#999999" WIDTH="100%" ALIGN="CENTER">

<Center><DIV STYLE="width:8.5in" align="left">
 <P STYLE="margin-top:0pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">connection with the Fund&#8217;s financial statement audits and its evaluation of disclosure controls and
procedures and internal control over financial reporting, including in connection with the certifications required under Rules <FONT STYLE="white-space:nowrap">13a-14</FONT> and <FONT STYLE="white-space:nowrap">15d-14</FONT> under the Exchange Act
of 1934, as amended; and (iii)&nbsp;cooperate with the Fund&#8217;s compliance program adopted pursuant to Rule <FONT STYLE="white-space:nowrap">38a-1</FONT> under the 1940 Act, including by providing summaries of its relevant policies and
procedures and by promptly reporting any material compliance matter relating to the Services. </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:4%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">2. <U>Duties of the Fund and the
Administrator</U> </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:4%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">(a) The Fund and the Administrator shall be responsible for accurately and timely supplying HSFT, or causing HSFT to be
supplied, with complete financial and other information in English with respect to the Fund that is necessary in order for HSFT to provide the Services. </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:4%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">(b) The Fund and the Administrator shall be responsible for the accurate and timely supplying HSFT, or causing HSFT to be supplied, with
complete financial information by any third party retained by the Fund in order for HSFT to provide the Services. </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:4%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">(c) The Fund and the
Administrator acknowledge that HSFT is not a public accounting or auditing firm, is not a fiduciary of a public accounting or auditing firm, and does not provide public accounting or auditing services or advice. </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:4%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">(d) The Fund, and not HSFT, shall pay all commissions, margins, option premiums, interest charges, floor commissions and fees, and other
transaction costs and expenses charged and incurred with respect to the Fund by broker-dealers and their agents. </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:4%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">(e) The Fund and the
Administrator will provide prompt notice to HSFT of any amendments and/or additional supplements to its Offering Memorandum. </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:4%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">(f) The Fund
and the Administrator will be entirely responsible for maintaining the confidentiality of the username(s) and password(s) provided to it by HSFT for purposes of accessing the FTP Site and any HSFT application, shall neither use the FTP Site or any
HSFT application username(s) and password(s) of another person at any time, nor disclose its FTP Site or any HSFT application username(s) and password(s) to any <FONT STYLE="white-space:nowrap">non-authorized</FONT> person, and shall be solely
responsible for any and all uses of its FTP Site or any HSFT application username(s) and password(s). In addition, the Fund or the Administrator will notify HSFT immediately if it suspects any unauthorized use of its FTP Site or any HSFT application
username(s) and password(s), or if any authorized person with access to the FTP Site or any HSFT application terminates its relationship with the Fund or the Administrator so access can be terminated. </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:4%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">3. <U>Compensation.</U> </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:4%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">(a) In
consideration of the Services to be rendered by HSFT under this Agreement, the Administrator shall pay HSFT a monthly service fee calculated and payable in advance (the <FONT STYLE="white-space:nowrap">&#8220;Sub-Administrative</FONT> Services
Fee&#8221;), as provided on the attached <U>Exhibit B</U>, or otherwise agreed to by HSFT, the Fund and the Administrator in writing from time to time. </P>
 <p STYLE="margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:0pt ; font-size:8pt">&nbsp;</P> <P STYLE="margin-top:0pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman" ALIGN="center">6 </P>

</DIV></Center>


<p style="margin-top:1em; margin-bottom:0em; page-break-before:always"> </p>
<HR SIZE="3" style="COLOR:#999999" WIDTH="100%" ALIGN="CENTER">

<Center><DIV STYLE="width:8.5in" align="left">
 <P STYLE="margin-top:0pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:4%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">(b) On the fifth (5th) business day of each month, HSFT shall forward to the Administrator
an itemized statement setting forth the calculation of the <FONT STYLE="white-space:nowrap">Sub-Administrative</FONT> Services Fee due to HSFT in respect of the current month. Unless the Administrator objects to the itemized statement within fifteen
(15)&nbsp;business days following receipt thereof, the <FONT STYLE="white-space:nowrap">Sub-Administrative</FONT> Services Fee will be due and payable by the Administrator to HSFT within fifteen (15) business days following receipt of the itemized
statement. If the amount of the <FONT STYLE="white-space:nowrap">Sub-Administrative</FONT> Services Fee for any particular month is revised or recalculated as a result of correct objections made by the Administrator to the applicable itemized
statement within fifteen (15)&nbsp;business days of the receipt thereof, the statement for the <FONT STYLE="white-space:nowrap">Sub-Administrative</FONT> Services Fee payable for the then current month shall include appropriate adjustments to
reflect the change in the <FONT STYLE="white-space:nowrap">Sub-Administrative</FONT> Services fee for the prior month. In the event the Administrator objects to a statement, the Parties shall use their best efforts to resolve the disputed amount(s)
as soon as possible, and the amounts deemed by the Parties to be correct shall be paid or refunded by the applicable Party as soon as practicable following the determination of the correct amount. If the Administrator does not object to an itemized
statement within thirty (30)&nbsp;business days of the receipt thereof, then, absent manifest error, such statement shall be deemed to be conclusively correct and may only be revised or recalculated as a result of HSFT&#8217;s recalculation of the <FONT
STYLE="white-space:nowrap">Sub-Administrative</FONT> Services Fee in accordance with the terms hereof. A &#8220;business day&#8221; is any day other than (a)&nbsp;Saturday and Sunday and (b)&nbsp;any other day in which banks located in New York City
are closed. </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:4%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">(c) On the fifth (5<SUP STYLE="font-size:75%; vertical-align:top">th</SUP>) business day of each month, HSFT shall forward to
the Administrator an itemized statement of all <FONT STYLE="white-space:nowrap"><FONT STYLE="white-space:nowrap">out-of-pocket</FONT></FONT> expenses (e.g., market data, <FONT STYLE="white-space:nowrap">pre-approved</FONT> travel, phone, postage,
faxes, copying etc.) incurred by HSFT in connection with the provision of the Services pursuant to this Agreement in respect of the prior month. <FONT STYLE="white-space:nowrap"><FONT STYLE="white-space:nowrap">Out-of-pocket</FONT></FONT> expenses
will include any market data license fees for any additional market data that will be required for HSFT to provide its services. In all cases, HSFT must obtain the written consent of the Administrator prior to incurring such monthly <FONT
STYLE="white-space:nowrap"><FONT STYLE="white-space:nowrap">out-of-pocket</FONT></FONT> fees in excess of $1,000. Unless the Administrator object to the itemized statement within fifteen (15)&nbsp;business days following receipt thereof, the
expenses will be due and payable by the Administrator to HSFT within fifteen (15)&nbsp;business days following receipt of the itemized statement. If the Administrator objects to such statement within a reasonable amount of time after the receipt
thereof not to exceed fifteen (15)&nbsp;business days, the Parties shall use their best efforts to resolve the disputed amount(s) as soon as possible, and the amounts deemed by the Parties to be correct shall be paid or refunded by the applicable
Party as soon as practicable following the determination of the correct amount. </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:4%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">(d) The fees and other amounts payable by the
Administrator to HSFT under this Agreement do not include any Taxes of any jurisdiction that may be assessed or imposed upon the Services provided by HSFT under this Agreement, or otherwise assessed or imposed in connection with the transactions
contemplated by this Agreement, including sales, use, excise, value added, personal property, export, import and withholding taxes, excluding only Taxes based upon HSFT&#8217;s income or otherwise properly allocable to and due and payable by HSFT in
respect of the services provided hereunder. The Administrator shall directly pay any such Taxes assessed against it in connection with this Agreement shall promptly reimburse HSFT for any such Taxes payable or collectable by HSFT on behalf or with
respect to this Agreement; provided that HSFT agrees to provide to the Administrator information reasonably requested by the Administrator in connection with this Section&nbsp;3(d). For purposes of this Agreement, &#8220;Taxes&#8221; mean any
applicable taxes, withholding taxes, levies, duties, VAT, transaction fees, currency exchange fees, transfer pricing costs and other similar taxes, assessments, fees or charges imposed by a governmental body. </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:4%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">(e) HSFT shall provide to Administrator such forms (including IRS Form <FONT STYLE="white-space:nowrap">W-8),</FONT> documentation or other
information as is necessary to reduce or eliminate taxes, fines or penalties. </P>

the provision of Services under this Agreement. </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:4%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">5. <U>Confidentiality</U>. </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:4%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">(a) HSFT agrees to keep confidential all accounting, customer, trading and other information, business records, business practices, financial
data, procedures and policies, security protocols, agreements and transactions of or relating to the Fund, the Administrator or any of their respective affiliates (&#8220;Confidential Information&#8221;). For the avoidance of doubt, Confidential
Information includes the Fund Documents, information regarding the market positions, trade data, investments, portfolio holdings, trading strategies, investor identity and information and other proprietary and confidential information of the Fund
and the Administrator and their affiliates, including all such information provided to HSFT by the Fund or the Administrator prior to the Effective Date. HSFT agrees that it shall: (i)&nbsp;maintain the confidentiality of Confidential Information;
(ii)&nbsp;appropriately instruct employees and other authorized persons who may be accorded access to Confidential Information by HSFT to maintain the confidentiality of the Confidential Information; and (iii)&nbsp;not use or process Confidential
Information for any purpose other than in fulfillment of its obligations under this Agreement. HSFT further represents that each of its employees, directors, consultants and agents is aware of HSFT&#8217;s obligations pursuant to this Section&nbsp;5
and is subject to an obligation of confidentiality with respect to the Confidential Information. HSFT shall promptly notify the Fund and the Administrator of any unauthorized release or access of such Confidential Information. Notwithstanding the
foregoing, HSFT may disclose Confidential Information (A)&nbsp;to service providers of HSFT who have a need to access such information in order to assist HSFT in the performance of the Services and who have agreed to confidentiality terms no less
protective than those set forth in this Section&nbsp;5(a), (B) to any person listed on Exhibit C (as Exhibit C may be amended from time to time by written agreement of the parties), (C) to any person for whom the Fund or the Administrator has given
prior written consent (email being sufficient) and (D)&nbsp;in consultation with the Fund and Administrator to the extent permitted under law, if required or requested to do so by any regulatory authority having jurisdiction over the Fund, the
Administrator or HSFT or if required to do so by judicial or administrative process or by applicable law or regulation. If HSFT, based on the advice of counsel, is legally compelled to disclose any Confidential Information, HSFT agrees that it will
furnish only that portion of the Confidential Information that it believes is legally required to be disclosed and HSFT will inform the party to which such Confidential Information is being disclosed of its confidential nature. In case of any
requests or demands for inspection of the records of the Fund or the Administrator or otherwise to disclose Confidential Information to any regulatory authority having jurisdiction over the Fund, the Administrator or HSFT or as required to do so by
judicial or administrative process or by applicable law or regulation, HSFT will use reasonable efforts, unless prohibited by law from making such notification, to notify the Fund and the Administrator promptly and to secure instructions from the
Fund and the Administrator as to such inspection, including to provide the Fund and/or the Administrator the opportunity to pursue such legal or other action as the Fund and/or the Administrator may desire to prevent or limit the disclosure of such
Confidential Information, provide reasonable assistance to the Funda and/or Administrator </P>

than the protections utilized to protect HSFT&#8217;s own confidential information. If HSFT becomes aware of any actual or suspected unauthorized use of or access to Confidential Information or any privacy or data breach involving Confidential
Information (an &#8220;Incident&#8221;), HSFT will promptly take appropriate actions to contain and mitigate the Incident, including notification to the Fund and the Administrator as soon as possible, but at most within twenty-four (24)&nbsp;hours

<P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:4%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">6. <U>Processing and Procedures</U>. </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:4%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">(a) <I>Capital Calls, Distributions and Transfers of Interests Generally</I>. </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:9%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">(i) The Fund shall, in its sole discretion, approve all capital calls, transfers and distributions with respect to the Interests. HSFT&#8217;s
obligations in connection with any capital call, transfer or distribution of Interests shall be limited to acting upon the Proper Instructions provided to HSFT by the Fund or the Administrator, on behalf of the Fund, from time to time pursuant to
the terms of this Agreement. The Fund and the Administrator shall bear the responsibility and HSFT shall assume no liability for determining that Proper Instructions regarding capital calls, transfers and distributions meet the requirements
established by the Governing Documents and all applicable laws, rules and regulations. </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:9%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">(ii) HSFT shall send statements confirming the
completion of any such capital call, transfer or distribution of Interests. </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:4%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">(b) <I>Capital Calls and Transfers</I>. </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:9%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">(i) The Fund and the Administrator shall use commercially reasonable efforts to provide HSFT with Proper Instructions two business days (but
in any event no later than one business day) prior to any date during the term of this Agreement on which the Fund elects to initiate a capital call or allow a transfer of Interest, pursuant to the discretion accorded it under the Governing
Documents. </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:9%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">(ii) HSFT shall not be responsible for the payment of any original issue or other taxes required to be paid by the Fund, if
any, in connection with a capital call or transfer of any Interests in accordance with this Agreement. </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:4%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">(c) <I>Distribution of
Interests</I>. </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:9%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">(i) The Fund and the Administrator shall use commercially reasonable efforts to provide HSFT with Proper Instructions two
business days (but in any event no later than one business day) prior to any date during the term of this Agreement on which the Fund elect to pay a distribution pursuant to the discretion accorded them under the Governing Documents (the
&#8220;Distribution Date&#8221;). </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:9%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">(ii) On or before the Distribution Date, the prime broker or custodian for the Fund shall deposit into
an account an amount of cash sufficient for HSFT to effect a distribution payment to those investors specified in the Proper Instructions. HSFT shall not be liable for any improper payments made in accordance with distribution instructions provided
by the Administrator; <U>provided</U>, <U>however</U>, that HSFT shall remain liable for its own fraud, willful default, Gross Negligence or Willful Misconduct, and unless HSFT is otherwise directed by the distribution instructions, HSFT shall make
distributions in accordance with the payment instructions provided in the subscription documentation of those investors specified in the distribution Instructions. </P>

</U><U>and</U><U> </U><U>Electronic</U><U> </U><U>Signatures.</U> </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:4%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">(a) The Parties acknowledge and agree that the investors and

<P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:4%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">(a) HSFT shall at all times exercise reasonable care and diligence and act in good faith in the performance of its duties hereunder,

which evinces a serious or substantial disregard of, or indifference to, the harmful consequences thereof, and &#8220;Willful Misconduct&#8221; means an intentional act or failure to act with intentional disregard of the harm that could result
thereof. </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:4%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">(b) Without in any way limiting the generality of the foregoing and provided that HSFT has taken all reasonable and customary

regulation of other governmental action, communications disruption (including the Internet or other networked environment), act of terrorism, fire, public health crisis, or other cause, whether similar or dissimilar to any of the foregoing, in the
case of each of the foregoing, which was not within HSFT&#8217;s reasonable control (&#8220;Force Majeure Events&#8221;), except to the extent that HSFT shall fail to establish and implement its </P>

disaster recovery and business continuity plan and maintain appropriate <FONT STYLE="white-space:nowrap">back-up</FONT> and disaster recovery facilities as set forth below. HSFT represents that

terminate this Agreement and shall be entitled to a pro rata refund of any prepaid fees upon such termination. </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:4%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">(c) HSFT SHALL NOT BE

<P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:4%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">19. <U>Consent to Jurisdiction</U>. The Parties hereto agree that any action or proceeding arising directly, indirectly, or otherwise in
connection with, out of, related to, or from this Agreement, any breach hereof, or any transaction covered hereby, shall be resolved within the courts of the State of New York. Accordingly, the Parties consent and submit to the jurisdiction of such
courts. The Parties further agree that any such action or proceeding brought by either Party to enforce any right, assert any claim, or obtain any relief whatsoever in connection with this Agreement shall be brought by such Party exclusively in such
courts. </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:4%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">20. <U>Survival</U>. The provisions of this Agreement shall survive the termination hereof with respect to any matter arising
while this Agreement shall be in effect. </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:4%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">21. <U><FONT STYLE="white-space:nowrap">Non-Solicitation</FONT></U>. </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:4%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">(a) During the term of this Agreement, and for a period of twelve (12)&nbsp;months after the expiration or termination hereof, neither the
Fund nor the Administrator shall, directly or indirectly, either for themselves or on behalf of any other firm, person or entity, solicit to employ, employ or retain as a consultant or independent contractor, any person who during the preceding
twelve (12)&nbsp;month period was known by the Fund and the Administrator to be in the employment of HSFT and/or its affiliates. Nothing in this Agreement shall prevent the Fund and the </P>

Administrator or their affiliates from placing in general circulation any solicitation for employment (including by way of search firm) not specifically directed toward employees of the HSFT or
employing any person who responds thereto or otherwise contacts the Fund or the Administrator on his or her own initiative; provided that, the Fund and/or the Administrator, as applicable, and HSFT shall agree upon a date on which such employment or
retention would commence. </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:4%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">(b) During the term of this Agreement, and for a period of twelve (12)&nbsp;months after the expiration or
termination hereof, HSFT shall not, directly or indirectly, either for itself or on behalf of any other firm, person or entity, solicit to employ, employ or retain as a consultant or independent contractor, any person who during the preceding twelve
(12)&nbsp;month period was known by HSFT to be in the employment of the Fund, the Administrator and/or their affiliates. </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:4%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">(c) HSFT, on the
one part, and the Fund and the Administrator on the other part, each acknowledge and agree that due to the uniqueness of the services to be provided by, and access of, their respective employees, and the confidential nature of the information such
employees will possess, the covenants set forth herein are reasonable and necessary for the protection of their business and goodwill. HSFT, on the one part, and the Fund and the Administrator on the other part, expressly acknowledge the importance
to each of them of the covenants set forth in this Section&nbsp;21, and recognize that each of them would not enter into this Agreement and/or would not permit the access to its services, records or confidential information without the other&#8217;s
consent hereto. </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:4%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">22. <U>Counterparts</U>. This Agreement may be executed in counterparts, each of which shall be deemed an original but

<P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:4%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">25. <U>No Partnership or Joint Venture between the Parties.</U> Nothing contained herein shall be construed as to constitute a partnership or

<Center><DIV STYLE="width:8.5in" align="left">
 <P STYLE="margin-top:0pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman" ALIGN="center"><B>Schedule 1 Data Protection under the CCPA </B></P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:4%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">To the extent that the Administrator or the Fund is or becomes subject to the CCPA and HSFT processes any Personal Information governed by the
CCPA (including any applicable Investor Data) received from the Administrator or the Fund (or from the Fund&#8217;s trustees, members, partners, agents, investors or prospective investors) (&#8220;<B>Relevant Data</B>&#8221;) on behalf of the
Administrator or the Fund for the purposes of performing this Agreement, HSFT shall: </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:9%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">(i) not Sell or Share any Relevant Data; </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:9%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">(ii) not retain, use or disclose the Relevant Data for any purpose other than the limited and specified Business Purpose of performing the
Services set forth in <U>Exhibit A</U>, as updated from <FONT STYLE="white-space:nowrap"><FONT STYLE="white-space:nowrap">time-to-time,</FONT></FONT> including taking actions necessary to perform the Services in accordance with the terms of this
Agreement (for example, to perform fund accounting and other administration services for the Fund) or as otherwise permitted by the CCPA (including to comply with applicable law) (together, the &#8220;<B>Purpose</B>&#8221;), and not for any other
commercial purpose or outside the direct business relationship between the Administrator and HSFT (including by combining or updating the Relevant Data with Personal Information HSFT received from another source or collected from HSFT&#8217;s own
interaction with the Consumer), unless expressly permitted by the CCPA. HSFT acknowledges and agrees that the Administrator is only disclosing the Relevant Data to HSFT for the Purpose; </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:9%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">(iii) comply with all applicable sections of the CCPA, including providing the same level of privacy protection for the Relevant Data as
required of the Administrator or the Fund by the CCPA; </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:9%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">(iv) ensure that any persons authorised to process the Relevant Data by it
(including its employees, contractors, agents and subcontractors) have agreed to comply with appropriate obligations of confidentiality; </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:9%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">(v) implement appropriate technical and organisational security measures in accordance with the CCPA, where applicable, against
(a)&nbsp;unauthorised or unlawful access to, (b) unauthorised or unlawful alteration, disclosure, destruction, use or other unauthorised or unlawful processing of, (c)&nbsp;accidental loss or destruction of, or (d)&nbsp;damage to, the Relevant Data;
</P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:9%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">(vi) provide reasonable assistance to the Administrator in order to assist the Administrator or the Fund in meeting its obligations under
the CCPA with regard to data subject rights. HSFT reserves the right to charge a commercially reasonable fee for such assistance; </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:9%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">(vii)
in the case of a breach of section (a)(v) (a &#8220;<B>Personal Data Breach</B>&#8221;), without undue delay after HSFT becoming aware of any such incident, notify the Administrator of the Personal Data Breach; </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:9%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">(viii) at the discretion of the Administrator, delete or return all Relevant Data to the Administrator, on behalf of the Fund, and delete all
existing copies of it to the extent permitted by law, on termination of this Agreement (unless applicable law requires the storage of such Relevant Data by HSFT); </P>
 <p STYLE="margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:0pt ; font-size:8pt">&nbsp;</P> <P STYLE="margin-top:0pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman" ALIGN="center">28 </P>

</DIV></Center>


<p style="margin-top:1em; margin-bottom:0em; page-break-before:always"> </p>
<HR SIZE="3" style="COLOR:#999999" WIDTH="100%" ALIGN="CENTER">

<Center><DIV STYLE="width:8.5in" align="left">
 <P STYLE="margin-top:0pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:9%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">(ix) promptly notify the Administrator after it makes a determination that it can no longer
meet its obligations under the CCPA; and </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:9%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">(x) grant the Administrator the right, upon notice, to take reasonable and appropriate steps to
stop and remediate HSFT&#8217;s unauthorised use of Relevant Data (should it occur). </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:4%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">(b) HSFT, may from time to time transfer Relevant
Data to a <FONT STYLE="white-space:nowrap">sub-Service</FONT> Provider in performing its obligations under this Agreement; <I>provided </I>that (i)&nbsp;it shall notify the Administrator of such engagement and (ii)&nbsp;such engagement will be
pursuant to a written contract binding such <FONT STYLE="white-space:nowrap">sub-Service</FONT> Provider to the terms required by the CCPA. </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:4%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">(c) HSFT shall, on request, make available to the Administrator all information reasonably necessary to demonstrate HSFT&#8217;s compliance
with the obligations laid down in this Schedule and allow for and contribute to, at the Administrator&#8217;s sole expense, audits, including inspections conducted by the Administrator or another auditor mandated by the Administrator or the Fund, in
connection with the discharge by HSFT of its obligations under this Schedule. Any such inspection or audit shall be on not less than thirty (30)&nbsp;days&#8217; prior written notice, and shall take place during normal business hours and with
minimum disruption to the business and clients of HSFT. HSFT grants the Fund the right to, upon reasonable notice, take reasonable and appropriate steps to stop and remediate any actual unauthorised uses of the Relevant Data by HSFT. Nothing in this
Schedule shall entitle the Administrator, the Fund or an auditor mandated by the Fund to access any confidential information of another client of HSFT. </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:4%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">(d) If under the CCPA, HSFT or a <FONT STYLE="white-space:nowrap">sub-Service</FONT> Provider receives a request from a Consumer in relation
to his or her Relevant Data which is in the possession of HSFT or such sub-Service Provider, HSFT shall notify the Administrator within thirty (30)&nbsp;days of HSFT&#8217;s receipt of such request (or reasonably promptly after receiving notice from
such <FONT STYLE="white-space:nowrap">sub-Service</FONT> Provider of such request), and HSFT, in response to such request, shall (and shall direct any applicable <FONT STYLE="white-space:nowrap">sub-Service</FONT> Provider to) cooperate with the
Administrator or the Fund to enable the Administrator or the Fund to assess and respond to such Consumer&#8217;s request. In the case of a deletion request by the Administrator made under the CCPA, HSFT or the relevant
<FONT STYLE="white-space:nowrap">sub-Service</FONT> Provider may, if applicable, notify the Administrator of a valid exception to the obligation to comply with such deletion request, which may include completing the transaction for which the
Relevant Data was collected, complying with HSFT&#8217;s legal obligations, detecting security incidents, debugging to identify and repair errors that impair existing intended functionality or another valid exception under the CCPA. </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:4%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">(e) The Administrator warrants (i)&nbsp;that any Relevant Data provided by the Administrator to HSFT has been collected in accordance with the
CCPA and (ii)&nbsp;that the relevant Consumers have been informed of the specific purposes for which their Personal Information will be processed. The Administrator will ensure that it complies with the CCPA and that any instructions which it gives
to HSFT will comply with the CCPA. </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:4%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">(f) Nothing in this Agreement shall be constructed as preventing either party from taking such steps
as are necessary to comply with the CCPA or other applicable law. </P>
 <p STYLE="margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:0pt ; font-size:8pt">&nbsp;</P> <P STYLE="margin-top:0pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman" ALIGN="center">29 </P>

</DIV></Center>

<HR SIZE="3" style="COLOR:#999999" WIDTH="100%" ALIGN="CENTER">

<Center><DIV STYLE="width:8.5in" align="left">
 <P STYLE="margin-top:0pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:4%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">(g) For the purposes of this Schedule: </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:9%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">(i) <B>Business Purpose </B>has the meaning given to that term in the CCPA; </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:9%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">(ii) <B>Consumer </B>has the meaning given to that term in the CCPA; </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:9%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">(iii) <B>Investor Data </B>means Personal Information relating to investors or prospective investors who are individuals and, to the extent
relevant, to the directors, officers, employees or beneficial owners of entity investors or prospective investors, including but not limited to the relevant investors&#8217; or other individuals&#8217; name(s), current residence address(es) and tax
residence(s), mailing address(es), date and place of birth, phone number(s), tax identification number(s), account number(s) (or functional equivalent); </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:9%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">(iv) <B>Personal Information </B>has the meaning given to that term in the CCPA; </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:9%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">(v) <B>Sell </B>has the meaning given to that term in the CCPA; </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:9%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">(vi) <B>Service Provider </B>has the meaning given to that term in the CCPA; and </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:9%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">(vii) <B>Share </B>has the meaning given to that term in the CCPA. </P>
